# Agix Technologies

> > AI systems engineering and agentic intelligence company specializing in enterprise AI automation and operational intelligence solutions.

Agix Technologies focuses on delivering advanced AI systems engineering services, including agentic intelligence platforms, workflow automation, and strategic AI assessments for enterprise clients. The company provides end-to-end AI solutions that enhance operational efficiency and business intelligence.
